key_principles: Generous white space (p-16 to p-32 padding)
Contrast between elegant serif headings and clean sans-serif body
Very light or no animations (static feel)
Earthy palette reflecting nature and premium coffee quality

scales.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-[1.1] text-primary
scales.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-snug text-primary
scales.label: text-xs sm:text-sm font-sans uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-accent

buttons.primary: inline-flex items-center justify-center font-sans tracking-wide bg-primary text-white px-8 py-4 hover:bg-primary/90 transition-colors duration-300
buttons.secondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center font-sans tracking-wide bg-transparent text-primary border border-primary px-8 py-4 hover:bg-primary hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300

product_card.style: bg-surface border border-border flex flex-col p-6 sm:p-8 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-300
product_card.details: flex flex-col gap-3 w-full text-center flex-grow
product_card.button: mt-6 w-full py-3 border border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-white transition-colors font-sans text-sm tracking-widest uppercase

impact_card.style: flex flex-col p-8 sm:p-10 bg-secondary/30 border border-border rounded-sm h-full

sections.name: Hero
sections.layout: Min-h-[90vh] flex items-center relative overflow-hidden bg-background pt-20
sections.instructions: Use grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 container mx-auto. Left side: overline label, main heading, subtext, 2 CTAs. Right side: A large, elegant vertical image of the Rwanda landscape or farming. Maintain breathing room.

sections.name: About
sections.layout: py-24 sm:py-32 container mx-auto grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-12 md:gap-20 items-center
sections.instructions: Left: High quality image of women farmers. Right: 'OUR STORY' label, H2 heading, and 2-3 paragraphs of body text detailing the connection between Rwanda/Burundi farmers and the German market.

sections.name: Products
sections.instructions: Container with a centered text header. A grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8 layout for the 5 coffees. Each product needs: origin, roast, tasting notes, price, short desc, Request Quote button. The Request Quote button should scroll to the contact form or trigger mailto.

sections.name: Founder
sections.instructions: Bento-style layout or a clean 2-column grid. Founder portrait image (Nsabemungu Christian Aime) paired with a quote and personal story. Use a subtle background color like #E8E0D5 (secondary) for the container.

sections.name: Impact
sections.instructions: Centered header. Grid of 3 impact cards highlighting community, sustainability, and direct trade. Minimalist look using typography and high white space.

sections.name: Contact
sections.layout: py-24 sm:py-32 bg-background border-t border-border container mx-auto grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-16
sections.instructions: Left: Minimalist contact form (Name, Email, Message, Submit). Right: Contact details (Lüneburg Germany, Email, Phone). Form should use Shadcn but styled with flat colors (no heavy shadows/radii).

sections.name: Footer
sections.instructions: Minimal layout. Brand logo (typography based), simple navigation links, and copyright.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', or 'Open Sans' font. Use 'Playfair Display' for all headings and 'Manrope' for body text. Add these via Google Fonts in index.html or global css.
Do NOT add heavy animations. Keep transitions limited to hover states (buttons, cards).
Follow the generous spacing system strictly (e.g. py-24, py-32, gap-12, gap-16) to ensure a premium, uncrowded feel.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.
Use standard Tailwind utilities with HTML tags. Do not rely heavily on Shadcn 'Card' wrappers as they can restrict layout; build raw divs for layouts instead.
For the form, use Shadcn Form elements (Input, Textarea, Button), but heavily customize them to remove borders/shadows, keeping them flat and minimal with a 1px border using border-border color.
Product Cards: Image, Title, Origin, Roast, Tasting Notes, Price, Description, Request Quote CTA. Ensure consistent alignment inside cards.
Hero: Left align the content. The layout should look editorial and elegant. Use a solid background, no gradients.
Ensure color contrast meets standards. Forest green text on off-white, white text on forest green background.
